question: Which of these nutrients gives our body quick energy to run and play? 🏃
explanation: Excellent! Carbohydrates, found in foods like bread and rice, act like fuel to give our body instant energy to stay active! 🍞
hint: You get a lot of this from rice, potatoes, and bread.

question: Which nutrient is known as a 'body-building' food that helps us grow tall and strong? 💪
explanation: Awesome! Proteins help build our muscles and repair our body when we get a scrape. They are true body-builders! 🥚
hint: Foods like dal, milk, eggs, and meat are full of this.

question: Which nutrient acts like our body's backup battery by storing extra energy? 🔋
explanation: Great job! Fats give us even more energy than carbohydrates and help keep our bodies warm like a cozy blanket! 🥑
hint: Butter, oil, and nuts are rich in this.

question: What do we call the super-nutrients that protect our body from diseases and keep us healthy? 🛡️
explanation: Brilliant! Vitamins and minerals act like little shields for our body, fighting off germs and keeping our eyes, bones, and skin healthy! 🥗
hint: Fruits and green leafy vegetables are packed with these.

question: Which part of our food doesn't give nutrients but acts like a broom to keep our tummy clean? 🧹
explanation: Fantastic! Roughage, or dietary fiber, helps food move smoothly through our digestive system and keeps our tummy happy! 🌾
hint: You find a lot of this in whole grains and fresh fruits.

question: What liquid makes up most of our body and helps absorb nutrients from our food? 💧
explanation: Super! Water is essential for life! It helps absorb nutrients and cools our body down through sweating. 🥛
hint: You should drink 6 to 8 glasses of this every day.

question: Which vitamin is famous for keeping our gums healthy and fighting off colds? 🍊
explanation: Awesome! Vitamin C is a superhero for our immunity and keeps our teeth and gums super strong! 🍋
hint: It is found in sour, citrus fruits like lemons, oranges, and amla.

question: What is the best natural source of Vitamin D, which helps make our bones super strong? ☀️
explanation: Excellent! When we play outside in the morning sunlight, our skin magically makes Vitamin D to keep our bones strong! 🌅
hint: It's not a food, but something that shines in the sky.

question: Which mineral is super important for building strong bones and teeth? 🦷
explanation: Great job! Calcium is the building block for strong, healthy bones and a bright, beautiful smile! 🥛
hint: Drinking milk gives you a lot of this mineral.

question: Which dark leafy vegetable is famous for being packed with Iron to keep our blood healthy? 🥬
explanation: Brilliant! Spinach is full of iron, which helps our body make healthy red blood cells to carry oxygen everywhere! 🥬
hint: Popeye the Sailor Man eats this to get strong!

question: If you add a few drops of Iodine to a potato, it turns blue-black. What nutrient does this test for? 🥔
explanation: Fantastic! The iodine test is a fun science trick! If food turns blue-black, it means it is packed with energy-giving starch! 🍚
hint: This is a type of carbohydrate found in potatoes and rice.

question: If you wrap a food item in paper and crush it, and it leaves an oily patch, what does the food contain? 📝
explanation: Awesome! That oily patch is a clear sign that the food has fats, which store energy for our body! 🥜
hint: Think about what happens when you hold a greasy samosa in a paper napkin.

question: Which of these is the best example of a healthy, balanced diet? 🥗
options: Eating dal, roti, veggies, and a fruit 🍱
answer: Eating dal, roti, veggies, and a fruit 🍱
explanation: Excellent! A balanced diet has the perfect mix of all nutrients—carbs, proteins, vitamins, and minerals—to keep you growing wonderfully! 🍱
hint: It means having a variety of different foods on your plate.

question: What is the best reason to avoid eating too much junk food? 🍔
options: It has too much fat and sugar, but very few vitamins 🍟
answer: It has too much fat and sugar, but very few vitamins 🍟
explanation: Great job! While junk food might taste good sometimes, our bodies need real vitamins and proteins to stay strong and active! 🍟
hint: Think about what junk food is missing to keep you healthy.

question: What does 'Mindful Eating' mean? 🧘
options: Paying attention to your food and chewing slowly 🍽️
answer: Paying attention to your food and chewing slowly 🍽️
explanation: Brilliant! Mindful eating helps us enjoy the flavor of our food and helps our tummy digest everything perfectly! 🍽️
hint: It means being completely focused on your delicious meal.

question: Which vitamin gets easily destroyed by heat during cooking? 🔥
explanation: Super! Vitamin C is very delicate and disappears when heated, which is why eating fresh, raw fruits is so amazing for you! 🍋
hint: This vitamin is found in lemon and amla.

question: Why should we wash fruits and vegetables BEFORE cutting them, instead of after? 🚰
options: To prevent washing away important vitamins 🛡️
To make them easier to chew 🦷
answer: To prevent washing away important vitamins 🛡️
explanation: Fantastic! Washing veggies before cutting them ensures we keep all those wonderful vitamins locked inside for our bodies! 🛡️
hint: Think about nutrients dissolving in water.

question: Eating too much fat-rich food like fried snacks every day can lead to a condition called what? ⚖️
explanation: Awesome! Our body stores extra fat, and too much of it can make us heavy and less active, known as obesity. Balance is key! 🍔
hint: It starts with the letter 'O' and means having too much body weight.

question: A lack of Vitamin A in our diet can cause which problem? 👁️
explanation: Excellent! Vitamin A is the superhero for our eyes! Eating carrots and papayas keeps our vision sharp, even in dim light! 🕶️
hint: This vitamin helps you see clearly.

question: A deficiency of Vitamin B1 causes a disease called Beriberi. What happens in this disease? 🛌
options: Weak muscles and very little energy 🔋
answer: Weak muscles and very little energy 🔋
explanation: Great job! Vitamin B1 gives our muscles energy. Eating unpolished grains and beans keeps Beriberi away and keeps you active! 🔋
hint: You feel very tired and weak.

question: Scurvy is a disease where gums bleed and wounds take longer to heal. Which vitamin prevents this? 🍊
explanation: Brilliant! Vitamin C is amazing for healing! Eating citrus fruits keeps your gums strong and prevents Scurvy! 🍋
hint: Sailors used to get this when they didn't have fresh lemons on ships.

question: If someone's bones become soft and bent, they might have Rickets. Which vitamin do they need? 🦴
explanation: Fantastic! Vitamin D helps our bones absorb calcium. Spending time in the morning sun keeps our bones strong and straight! ☀️
hint: This is the sunshine vitamin!

question: Which important mineral helps prevent a swollen neck disease called Goiter? 🧂
explanation: Super! Iodine is vital for our neck glands. Using iodized salt in our food is a simple and amazing way to stay healthy! 🧂
hint: We usually get this added to our table salt.

question: A deficiency of Iron causes Anemia. How does someone with Anemia usually feel? 🥱
explanation: Awesome! Iron helps carry oxygen in our blood. Eating apples and spinach gives you iron and keeps you full of energy! 🥱
hint: Without iron, the body feels like a toy running out of battery.

question: Which of these is a fantastic traditional Indian 'superfood' grain that is very healthy? 🌾
explanation: Excellent! Millets are traditional super-grains packed with fiber and minerals that give you long-lasting energy and strength! 🥣
hint: These are ancient grains that your grandparents probably ate a lot.

question: What happens when you soak whole moong or chana in water and leave it wrapped in a wet cloth for a day? 🌱
options: They sprout, becoming even more nutritious 🌱
answer: They sprout, becoming even more nutritious 🌱
explanation: Great job! Sprouting awakes the seed, making it burst with extra vitamins and proteins. Sprouted moong is a delicious, healthy snack! 🌱
hint: Little white tails grow out of the seeds.

question: What is the best way to cook food so it doesn't lose its wonderful nutrients? 🍲
options: Frying it in a lot of oil 🍟
Steaming or boiling with a little water ♨️
answer: Steaming or boiling with a little water ♨️
explanation: Brilliant! Steaming is a gentle way of cooking that keeps all the fantastic vitamins and minerals locked inside the food! ♨️
hint: Think of how idlis or momos are cooked.

question: Which of these pairs represents the major 'Energy-giving foods'? ⚡
explanation: Fantastic! Carbs give you quick energy, and fats give you stored energy. Together, they are the best energy team! 🍚🧈
hint: Think of foods like rice, bread, butter, and oil.

question: Which of these helps our body fight against diseases the best? 🛡️
explanation: Super! Fresh fruits like oranges are packed with Vitamin C, which builds a strong shield against cold and cough germs! 🍊
hint: Look for the natural food packed with vitamins.

question: To stay wonderfully healthy, which type of fruits should we try to eat the most? 🍎
options: Canned fruits with lots of sugar 🥫
explanation: Awesome! Nature knows best! Eating fruits that grow in your area during their proper season gives you the freshest, best nutrients! 🍉
hint: Think about mangoes in summer and apples in winter.

question: Why do our bodies need food every day? 🍽️
options: For energy, growth, and repairing the body 🚀
answer: For energy, growth, and repairing the body 🚀
explanation: Excellent! Food is our body's amazing fuel and building block. It helps us grow tall, play hard, and heal quickly! 🚀
hint: Think about why a car needs petrol.

question: Which amazing nutrient acts like a builder to heal a cut on your finger? 🩹
explanation: Great job! Proteins are the body's repair crew. They quickly work together to heal cuts and build new skin! 🥚
hint: This is known as the body-building food.

question: Which food item is a complete package of proteins, fats, calcium, and vitamins, and is great for growing kids? 🥛
explanation: Brilliant! Milk is considered almost a complete food because it packs so many wonderful nutrients that help you grow strong! 🥛
hint: You usually drink it warm or cold in a glass.

question: Which of these habits is part of 'Mindful Eating'? 🧘
options: Taking more food than you can eat 🍽️
Listening to your tummy and stopping when full 🛑
answer: Listening to your tummy and stopping when full 🛑
explanation: Fantastic! Listening to your body helps you eat just the right amount, keeping your tummy perfectly happy and healthy! 🛑
hint: It means paying attention to how hungry or full you feel.

question: Roughage is another name for what important part of our food? 🌾
explanation: Super! Roughage and dietary fiber are the same fantastic thing! They keep our digestive system running smoothly. 🥬
hint: It starts with an 'F'.

question: Which is the best healthy snack option when you are hungry between meals? 🥕
options: A bowl of fresh salad or fruits 🥗
answer: A bowl of fresh salad or fruits 🥗
explanation: Awesome! Fresh fruits and salads are deliciously crunchy and packed with vitamins that give you a wonderful boost of energy! 🥗
hint: Pick the natural, colorful option.

question: What happens if we overcook our vegetables for a very long time? 🍲
options: They lose many of their important nutrients 💧
answer: They lose many of their important nutrients 💧
explanation: Excellent! Cooking veggies just the right amount keeps them colorful, crunchy, and full of wonderful vitamins! 💧
hint: Heat can destroy certain good things in food.

question: In the Copper Sulfate and Caustic Soda test, what color tells us that Proteins are present? 🧪
explanation: Great job! It's like magic! When the solution turns a beautiful violet or purple color, we know proteins are safely inside the food! 🟣
hint: It's the color of an eggplant (brinjal).

question: Which of these does NOT provide any energy or body-building material, but is still absolutely essential for our body? 🚰
explanation: Brilliant! Water doesn't have calories or vitamins, but it is the magical river inside us that makes all bodily functions work perfectly! 💧
hint: You drink it when you are thirsty.

question: A balanced diet depends mostly on what two factors? ⚖️
options: Your age and the type of physical work you do 🏃‍♂️
answer: Your age and the type of physical work you do 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Fantastic! A growing child or an athlete needs different energy than an adult resting at home. Our bodies are smart and unique! 🏃‍♂️
hint: Think about who uses more energy: a playing child or a sleeping person.

question: Why is it wonderful to include unpolished rice and whole wheat flour in our diet? 🌾
options: They are rich in roughage and B-vitamins 🍞
They have no nutrients at all 🚫
answer: They are rich in roughage and B-vitamins 🍞
explanation: Super! The outer cover of grains holds amazing fiber and vitamins. Whole grains keep you energized for a long time! 🍞
hint: They haven't had their healthy outer layer removed.

question: Which of these is a great plant-based source of protein? 🌱
explanation: Awesome! Dal, beans, and soybeans are amazing plant heroes packed with protein to help you grow strong without needing animal products! 🥣
hint: You often eat this in a bowl with rice or roti.

question: Which of these is a great animal-based source of fats? 🧈
explanation: Excellent! Butter is deliciously made from milk, which comes from cows or buffaloes, making it a great animal source of energy! 🧈
hint: This is made from milk.

question: To prevent wasting food, what is the best habit to follow? 🍽️
options: Throw leftover food in the trash 🗑️
Take only as much as you can eat on your plate 🥘
Feed all your food to the dog 🐕
answer: Take only as much as you can eat on your plate 🥘
explanation: Great job! Being mindful of portion sizes respects the food and the farmers who grew it. You can always take a second helping if you're still hungry! 🥘
hint: Think about portion control.

question: If you play sports and run a lot, which nutrient do you need more of to keep your energy up? 🏃‍♀️
explanation: Brilliant! Athletes love carbohydrates because they are the quickest way to top up your energy levels for running and playing! 🍞
hint: Think of the quick energy nutrient.

question: Which of these foods is considered 'Junk Food' because it has empty calories and very few nutrients? 🍕
explanation: Fantastic! Fizzy drinks have lots of sugar but no vitamins. Choosing water, milk, or fresh juice makes your body so much happier! 🥤
hint: It comes in cans and bottles and is very sweet and bubbly.

question: How do roughage and water work together as a super-team in our body? 🤝
options: They help our eyes see in the dark 🦉
They help smoothly remove undigested waste from the body 🚽
answer: They help smoothly remove undigested waste from the body 🚽
explanation: Super! Roughage acts like a sponge, and water helps it sweep through our digestive system, keeping our tummies clean and healthy! 🚽
hint: Think of digestion and cleaning out the stomach.

question: A lack of Calcium and Phosphorus over a long time will most likely lead to what? 🦷
explanation: Awesome! Calcium and Phosphorus are best friends that work together to make your smile bright and your bones unbreakable! 🦴
hint: Think about what makes up your skeleton and teeth.

question: Eating food in front of a screen (TV or phone) often leads to what bad habit? 📺
explanation: Excellent! When we watch TV, our brain is distracted. Turning off the screen lets us enjoy every bite and stops us from overeating! 🍔
hint: When you are distracted, you don't listen to your stomach.

question: What is the ultimate secret to a healthy body and a happy mind? 🌟
options: Eating a balanced diet, playing outside, and being mindful 🚴‍♂️🥗
answer: Eating a balanced diet, playing outside, and being mindful 🚴‍♂️🥗
explanation: Great job! A healthy balance of good food, active play, and mindful eating gives you the magic formula for an amazing, happy life! 🚴‍♂️🥗
hint: It includes everything good we learned in this chapter.
